name: SGLang ROCm-specific configuration and AITER integration for AMD GPUs
workarounds: SGLang uses AITER as the default kernel backend on ROCm Docker images
AITER integration replaces MoE, GEMM, attention, and all-reduce with optimized kernels
For DeepSeek-R1: SGLang + AITER achieves 14,635.98 token/s total throughput on MI300X
notes: SGLang on ROCm uses AITER as the default kernel backend in its Docker images. The AITER integration for DeepSeek-R1 replaces: (1) Complete MoE implementation (Top-K routing, MoE sorting, blockscale FP8 MoE computation), (2) FP8 blockscale GEMM for linear layers, (3) MLA decode attention and MHA prefill attention, (4) Custom all-reduce. Measured on MI300X with SGLang v0.4.4 + AITER: DeepSeek-R1 total throughput 14,635.98 token/s (median 2,255.85 token/s per decode step). The integration is based on a private repository (BruceXcluding/sglang tree aiter_customer_v0.4.4). SGLang's ROCm support is production-ready and listed in ROCm's supported frameworks. The key advantage over vLLM is SGLang's native RadixAttention for prefix caching, which complements AITER's kernel optimizations.
